categories.main_business_segments: Hanmi Pharm operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, divided into three segments: pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and overseas pharmaceuticals. The pharmaceutical segment focuses on prescription drugs including complex hypertension and hyperlipidemia treatments. The API segment produces raw materials for drugs, recognized for quality and compliance with global GMP standards. The overseas segment, mainly through Beijing Hanmi Pharmaceuticals, markets pediatric and adult respiratory medicines and collaborates on global drug development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary drug synthesis technologies and diversified pharmaceutical formulations, including complex and combination drugs. It maintains advanced cGMP-certified manufacturing facilities for APIs and finished products, with FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other international regulatory approvals. R&D emphasizes innovative drug development platforms such as long-acting biologics, targeted therapies, cell and gene therapies, and mRNA-based treatments. The company also employs integrated clinical and preclinical research supported by a large specialized R&D workforce.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanmi Pharm serves hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies primarily in South Korea and China, targeting patients with chronic diseases such as hypertension, hyperlipidemia, gastroesophageal reflux, and respiratory illnesses. Its products are prescription-based, marketed mainly to healthcare professionals. The company also licenses innovative drug candidates to global pharmaceutical partners for worldwide markets. The overseas segment focuses on pediatric and adult respiratory care products in China and other Asian markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea and China, with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Gyeonggi Province and Beijing. It exports APIs and finished products to over 40 countries worldwide. Strategic partnerships and licensing agreements extend its reach to the United States, Europe, and other global markets. The overseas pharmaceutical business is concentrated in China, while innovative drug development targets global commercialization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanmi Pharm operates across multiple points in the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream API production, midstream drug formulation and manufacturing, and downstream sales and distribution. It also engages in licensing out innovative drug candidates to global partners, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and an R&D-driven innovator within the pharmaceutical value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in innovative drug development, focusing on metabolic diseases, obesity, rare diseases, oncology, and immunology. It pursues a 'Korean-style R&D' strategy progressing from first-generation generics to complex and innovative new drugs. Hanmi emphasizes platform technologies such as long-acting biologics, targeted therapies, cell and gene therapies, and mRNA modalities. Open innovation and global partnerships are key to accelerating clinical development and commercialization. The company allocates approximately 13.8% of sales to R&D, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Hanmi Pharm generates revenue primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products and APIs in domestic and overseas markets. It also earns milestone and royalty income from licensing out innovative drug candidates to global pharmaceutical companies. The company’s revenue streams include product sales, contract manufacturing, and technology licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanmi Pharm is positioned as a leading innovative pharmaceutical company in South Korea, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and successful licensing deals with global partners such as MSD and Genentech. It competes with other top Korean pharmaceutical firms and multinational companies in both generic and innovative drug markets. The company holds a dominant position in complex hypertension and hyperlipidemia treatments domestically and is expanding its global footprint through strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Hanmi Pharm reported consolidated sales of approximately KRW 1.49 trillion, representing a 12% year-over-year increase. Operating profit grew by nearly 40%, supported by strong domestic sales and overseas growth, particularly in China. The company’s total assets stood at around KRW 1.9 trillion with a debt ratio of 72.6%, reflecting solid financial health. R&D expenses accounted for about 13.8% of sales, underscoring sustained investment in innovation. The company has demonstrated consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and R&D intensity over recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanmi Pharm emphasizes its unique value through innovative drug development based on proprietary synthesis and formulation technologies, delivering complex and long-acting combination therapies. Its strong R&D pipeline targeting metabolic, oncologic, and rare diseases differentiates it from competitors. The company’s global licensing partnerships validate its innovation capabilities and provide access to international markets. Additionally, Hanmi’s integrated approach combining domestic manufacturing excellence with global R&D collaborations enhances its competitive edge and future growth potential.
